steps.content: The man is winding some bandages around her wounds.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: I can relate to your feeling. You cannot accept it, and you cannot forgive. You'd rather burn it all down and destroy everything than run away or compromise.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: But don't forget that although violence may help you beat your enemies, you can't use it to create a new future.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: How should I put it? I know this place has never given you any good memories, but I've lived longer than you have, and I've seen the good old days...

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: When I was young, I never expected things would become as bad as they are now. Likewise, the situation may improve in the future, you're only limited by your imagination.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: You're very strong, and you'll only become stronger. You will gain many admirers and followers. You should lead them to write a brand new future rather than using your power solely to destroy.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: Before I retire, let your old man do something for you. Trust me just this once, Zoya. There's always hope in life.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: That fight I had with you among those thugs, that's the luckiest thing that's ever happened to me. And the best decision I've ever made is dragging you back and making you my buddy.
The shackles are growing hot, but in a warm and gentle way.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: Ugh... Ugh...

steps.speaker: Gang Hitman
steps.content: Oh, are you little Zoya? This geezer keeps mumbling about you... Too bad, you came too late.

steps.speaker: Gang Hitman
steps.content: There are questions you should never ask, and there are unspoken rules you should never challenge. Alas, our old sheriff didn't seem to understand these rules and was being stubborn, so someone paid me to do them a favor...

steps.speaker: Gang Hitman
steps.content: What's a Mania Crystal? You'll know when you experience it yourself... Hehehe... Do you wanna hear his last words? Ahahahaha...

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Superiors
steps.content: Leggett had repeatedly violated the West District Order Management Regulations, ignored warnings from his superiors, and purposely provoked conflicts. He'd long been removed from his position.

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Superiors
steps.content: Which means this case is an internal affair among gangs. The Public Security Bureau won't intervene. Also, haven't you already killed all of his murderers?

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Superiors
steps.content: Haha... Look at the power you possess. You're a Sinner now, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Superiors
steps.content: Seize her! You Sinner, you're the destroyer of order. Seize her! He's told you something, hasn't he? Root them out, root them out, root them out...
The gang hitman and the sheriff's faces are slowly overlapping, contorting, and splitting into countless filthy figures, growling and charging at Zoya.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Haha... What a fool...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Ol' man, that future you kept talking about, it doesn't exist...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: It doesn't exist!!

She lets out a guttural and heart-wrenching roar, pouring out all her regrets, grief, hatred, and bloodlust. The roar turns into growling purple flames, burning her everything and scorching your shackles.
You put yourself before her and face the reveling devils...
